_source: LoL 위키 TFT 아이템 문서의 2020-12-15 이전 마지막 판(MediaWiki API, prop=revisions, rvstart=2020-12-15). Set 4 진행 중에 저장된 판이다. onlyinclude 안의 정보 상자 칸만 옮겼다. 재료 문서는 조합표만 있어서 뺐다(장갑만 치명 10·회피 10). 2026-10-07 수집.

Bloodthirster.passive: Basic attacks heal for 40% of the damage dealt.

Blue Buff.recipe: Tear of the Goddess, Tear of the Goddess
Blue Buff.passive: After each spellcast, the wearer's mana is set to 20.

Bramble Vest.passive: Negates bonus damage from critical strikes on the wearer. When the wearer is hit by a basic attack, deals 80;100;150 magic damage to all nearby enemies (2.5 second cooldown).

Chalice of Power.recipe: Tear of the Goddess, Negatron Cloak
Chalice of Power.passive: At the start of combat, the wearer and all allies within 1 hex in the same row to the left and right gain 35 spell power for the rest of combat.

Deathblade.recipe: B. F. Sword, B. F. Sword
Deathblade.passive: Grant 20 bonus attack damage per stack. Starts at 1 stack. Gain 1 stack when participating in killing an enemy, including summoned units. Stacks with no upper limit.

Duelist's Zeal.passive: Wearer is also a Duelist. Cannot equip on a champion that is already a Duelist.

Elderwood Sprout.passive: Wearer is also a Elderwood. Cannot equip on a champion that is already a Elderwood.

Frozen Heart.recipe: Tear of the Goddess, Chain Vest
Frozen Heart.passive: Reduces the attack speed of adjacent enemies by 50% for 0.5 seconds.

Gargoyle Stoneplate.passive: The holder gains 15 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for each enemy targeting them.

Giant Slayer.passive: Basic attacks and spells gain 10% increased damage (pre-mitigation), increased to 90% if the enemy has over 1750 maximum health.

Guardian Angel.passive: Upon death, cleanses negative effects and revives after 2 seconds with 400 health. This effect can trigger once per combat.

Guinsoo's Rageblade.passive: Basic attacks grant 6% bonus attack speed for the rest of combat. Stacks with no upper limit.

Hand of Justice.recipe: Sparring Gloves, Tear of the Goddess
Hand of Justice.passive: At the start of each round, randomly gains one of the following buffs:

Hextech Gunblade.recipe: B. F. Sword, Needlessly Large Rod
Hextech Gunblade.passive: Special Abilities heal for 33% of the damage dealt. Excess healing with this item is converted into a shield up to 400 health.

Infinity Edge.passive: Converts every 1% excess critical strike chance into 1% bonus critical strike damage.

Ionic Spark.passive: Enemies within 2 hexes have their magic resistance reduced by 40% (does not stack). Additionally, when enemies within 2 hexes cast their Special Ability, they are dealt 225% of their maximum mana as magic damage.

Jeweled Gauntlet.passive: The wearer's Special Ability can critically strike. Additionally, grants 40% bonus critical strike damage.

Last Whisper.passive: Critical strike hits reduce the target's armor by 80% for 3 seconds. This effect does not stack.

Locket of the Iron Solari.passive: At the start of combat, the wearer and all allies within 2 hexes in the same row to the left and right gain a 300;375;500;800 health shield for 8 seconds.

Luden's Echo.recipe: Needlessly Large Rod, Tear of the Goddess
Luden's Echo.passive: When the wearer deals damage with their Special Ability, the first target hit and up to 3 enemies within 2 hexes of the target are dealt an additional 180 magic damage. Enemies who are crowd controlled are dealt an additional 180 true damage.

Mage's Hat.passive: Wearer is also a Mage. Cannot equip on a Mage champion.

Aspect of Dusk.passive: Wearer is also a Dusk. Cannot equip on a champion that is already a Dusk.

Morellonomicon.passive: Dealing magic damage with a spell applies a burn on the enemies hit for 10 seconds, dealing 2.5% of target's maximum health true damage each second and applying Grievous Wounds for the duration, reducing healing on the target.

Quicksilver.passive: The wearer is immune to crowd control effects for the first 10 seconds of combat.

Rabadon's Deathcap.recipe: Needlessly Large Rod, Needlessly Large Rod

Rapid Firecannon.passive: Triples attack range, and basic attacks cannot miss.

Redemption.recipe: Tear of the Goddess, Giant's Belt
Redemption.passive: On death heals all allies for 800 health. This effect can trigger once per combat.

Runaan's Hurricane.passive: Basic attacks fire an additional bolt at another nearby enemy, dealing 90% AD physical damage and applying on-hit effects. Bolts can critically strike and have infinite range.

Shroud of Stillness.passive: When combat begins, shoots a beam straight ahead in a 1.5-hex line that delays affected enemies' first spellcast, increasing their maximum mana by 33% until they cast.

Spear of Shojin.recipe: B. F. Sword, Tear of the Goddess
Spear of Shojin.passive: Basic attacks restore an additional 5 mana on-hit.

Statikk Shiv.recipe: Recurve Bow, Tear of the Goddess
Statikk Shiv.passive: Every third basic attack from the wearer deals 80 magic damage to the target and 2;3;4;8 additional targets. Enemies who are shielded are dealt an additional 240 true damage.

Sunfire Cape.passive: At start of combat, and every 2 seconds thereafter, applies a 10-second burn to a random enemy within 2 hexes, dealing 2.5% of target's maximum health true damage each second and applying Grievous Wounds for the duration, reducing healing on the target.

Sword of the Divine.passive: Wearer is also a Divine. Cannot equip on a champion that is already a Divine.

Thief's Gloves.passive: At the beginning of each round, the wearer equips 2 random items that are removed at the end of the round. The quality of these items are based on player level.

Titan's Resolve.passive: When the wearer takes damage from any source or inflicts a critical hit, gains 2% bonus damage for the rest of combat, stacking up 25 times for a maximum of 50%. At maximum stacks, additionally gains 25 bonus armor and bonus magic resistance, and increases in size. Resets every round.

Trap Claw.passive: At the beginning of each round, gains a spell shield that blocks the first enemy spell that hit. The enemy that breaks the shield is stunned for 4 seconds.

Vanguard's Cuirass.passive: Wearer is also a Vanguard. Cannot equip on a champion that is already a Vanguard.

Warlord's Banner.passive: Wearer is also a Warlord. Cannot equip on a champion that is already a Warlord.

Youmuu's Ghostblade.passive: Wearer is also an Assassin (including the Innate stealthed jump). Cannot equip on an Assassin champion.

Zeke's Herald.passive: At the start of combat, the wearer and all allies within 1 hex in the same row to the left and right gain 35% bonus attack speed for the rest of combat.

Zephyr.passive: At the start of combat, banishes for 5 seconds the unit that mirrors the wielder's placement on the other side of the board.

Zz'Rot Portal.passive: At the start of combat, the wearer taunts all nearby enemies for 1 second. Additionally, when the wearer dies, a Construct with 1500;2250;3000;5000 Health aries to continue the fight.
